hypotheses.claim: Binance's USD1.34B in-kind acquisition could create XRP spot or OTC demand if XRP is included in affected tokens still needing replacement.
support: Binance says purchases are made in affected token assets through market and OTC channels
counter_hypothesis: XRP-specific allocation, amount, execution venue and timing are undisclosed
Some of the USD1.34B may be allocated to other tokens or OTC counterparties

hypotheses.claim: XRP derivatives are experiencing long-dominated deleveraging.
support: Alpha Finance reports USD36.8M long versus USD2.5M short liquidations
Liqwall reports USD38.4M long versus USD2.4M short liquidations
Prior TradRadar panel also showed long-dominated liquidations
counter_hypothesis: Open-interest aggregates differ by more than 100% between providers
Funding is venue-dependent; Binance funding is positive while aggregate funding is slightly negative
Account ratios are not notional exposure

hypotheses.claim: October 29 ETF inflows were caused by or responded to the Binance XRP incident.
counter_hypothesis: ETF session closed 20:00 UTC, four minutes before the first XRPL incident transfer at 20:04 UTC

hypotheses.claim: The macro regime is mixed for crypto liquidity: yen normalization may tighten carry liquidity while USD weakness and lower Treasury yields can offset some pressure.
support: BOJ held 1.25% with hawkish outlook; yen about 157
Dollar weakened and Treasury yields fell
counter_hypothesis: No stable XRP-specific macro beta or causal estimate has been validated
